source_derivation.physical_operation: Start with whole BCC Voronoi owners at the declared cell mark. Retain one actual directed face-separator port per owner pair. Any continued step reassigns pair ports to actual separating faces before reconstructing the complete next state. No owner is clipped, and all intrinsic frames remain fixed.

source_derivation.source_inclusion: The canonical unit snub cube lies in beta times the canonical unit truncated cuboctahedron in the identity frame, beta=2R/(1+2sqrt2), where R=alpha²/sqrt(2+2alpha²) and alpha³=alpha²+alpha+1. The square-face radii agree. With y=1/alpha, the snub cube absolute coordinate set is R*{1,y,y²}; all pair and triple signed supports lie strictly inside the remaining TCO walls.
source_derivation.initial_whole_owner_lift: Multiply every complete source center by beta and replace each beta-scaled TCO by the enclosed canonical SNC in the same exact source quaternion.
source_derivation.source_frames: All source quaternions are retained exactly.
source_derivation.physical_return: Use the actual snub-cube supports and one feasible fixed-frame face or edge-cross separator for every owner pair. Restore all owner translations against the same38 snub-cube host walls. Repeated separator switches occur only at the complete preceding packing.
source_derivation.native_decoder: Stored centers are binary64 rounding of returned centers times(1+1e-7); s_full is outward-rounded nominal*(1+1e-7)+1e-7. All stored numbers are exact rational inputs for the native interval checker, which verifies every canonical vertex, wall and pair.
